title: Q2 Cohort Elevate: Cohort-driven roadmap & contingency plan for Hosted API + Model Catalog
creator: Aisha Romero
description: Goal: Create a cohort-driven quarterly roadmap that aligns Hosted API feature launches and model catalog rotations with clear contingency corridors. Scope: define prioritized customer cohorts (PLG, enterprise, platform teams), map hosting capacity constraints and model compatibility lanes, specify canary windows and rollback criteria, and produce an operational playbook for cross-functional owners. Success metrics: roadmap delivery adherence >= 85% by end of quarter; number of regression incidents attributable to model rotations <= 2; time-to-fallback (automatic region/model swap) <= 60s in simulated surge tests. Out of scope: underlying serving runtime kernel changes (handled by Runtime Eng), deep model retraining (handled by Research).
acceptance_criteria: Cohort definitions and priority matrix shared and approved by Growth, Sales, and CS
A runbook for canary windows + rollback per model tier published in Confluence with ownership
Contingency corridors (capacity/region/model fallback) documented and validated in two simulated surge runs
Stakeholder sign-off on release gating and dependency map from Eng, Infra, Security
